verdict.rationale: Letta explicitly supports isolated execution: a managed cloud sandbox for the web app (letta-docs-33, letta-docs-16/47), remote sandboxes on Pro plans (letta-docs-49), and an --ephemeral CLI mode that runs a one-shot task without creating, resuming, or persisting an agent, memory blocks, or MemFS (letta-docs-14/42) — letting users test without touching persistent/production state. Self-hosting on infrastructure you control (letta-docs-30) further supports isolating test environments from production. Missing for 10: explicit framing of 'production data' separation/staging vs prod environments, and independent/hands-on verification beyond first-party docs.
